entities.name: FtsH ATP-dependent protease
observations: 617-aa query has 55.3% identity and 99.4% coverage to reviewed Clostridium novyi FtsH (UniProt A0PXM8; E=1.43e-222).

FtsH homologs are membrane-associated ATP-dependent zinc metalloproteases implicated in protein quality control; hexameric organization and Zn2+ cofactor are reference annotations, not direct measurements for this query.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 68,036.6 Da; theoretical pI 5.30; GRAVY -0.217.
